units.source_text: 千重子后悔问了这些不得体的话。

en.t: Chieko regretted asking such improper questions.

units.source_text: 但是，她觉得还是不道歉为好。

en.t: But she felt it would be better not to apologize after all.

units.source_text: 那么，自己又怎么会忽然问起这个问题？

en.t: Then why had she suddenly brought up that question herself?

units.source_text: 连她自己也不明白，说不定是因为她模模糊糊地想起了真砂子说过的，

en.t: She herself did not understand it either; perhaps it was because she had vaguely remembered what Masako had said,

units.source_text: 北山杉村有个姑娘长得跟她一模一样……

en.t: that in the village of Kitayama cedars there was a girl who looked exactly like her...
